title: Taiwanese International Student Association
content_html:
The Taiwanese International Student Association (TiSA) at the University of Texas at Austin is a student organization focused on serving Taiwanese and Mandarin-speaking undergraduate students at UT Austin, as well as others interested in Taiwanese culture. TiSA is registered on UT Austin’s official HornsLink student organization directory and carries the Chinese name 德州大學台灣國際學生會. The organization maintains a website at uttisa.com, a Facebook page under the handle TiSAatUT (221 likes), and an Instagram account (@tisa_utaustin).

TiSA’s stated mission, as documented by UT Austin’s Center for Taiwan Studies, is to promote a sense of belonging for Taiwanese and Mandarin-speaking undergraduate students at UT Austin, as well as those interested in Taiwanese culture. The Center for Taiwan Studies (CTS) has served in an advisory role to TiSA, with the CTS director assuming the position of faculty advisor, reflecting a formal institutional connection to Taiwan-focused academic programming at the university. TiSA hosts general meetings, welcome events, and social programming each semester to welcome new members.
